item.title: Bullet Train Project Achieves 2nd Mountain Tunnel Breakthrough in Maharashtra
item.description: The Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train Project achieved a major milestone with the successful breakthrough of the second mountain tunnel in Palghar, Maharashtra on 3 Feb 2026. This tunnel is 454 metres long with a width of 14.4 metres, and will accommodate both up and down tracks for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train project. The mountain tunnel (MT-6) […]

item.title: How Railway Capex Is Being Spent in 2026-27: Projects and State-wise Allocations
item.description: The Union Budget 2026-27 has placed a strong emphasis on strengthening Indian Railways through sustained capital expenditure, with a sharp focus on safety upgrades, capacity expansion, and asset modernisation.
